faqs.q: Sec. 78-221. - Type of improvements subject to reimbursement.
faqs.a:
(a)
The owner of any property in the city who installs and dedicates street, sidewalk,
               water main, sewer main, bicycle trail, bridge, storm drainage facility not covered
               by unit drainage fee, or other public improvements, may apply for the establishment
               of a reimbursement assessment district to obtain reimbursement of a portion of the
               cost from the owners of property specially benefited by the improvements.
(b)
If the city constructs any such improvement which benefits the owners of private property,
               it may establish a reimbursement assessment district for its own benefit, subject,
               however, to all the terms and conditions of this article.
(Code 1981, § 27-181; Ord. No. 1721, § 1, 2-2-1981; Ord. No. 1764, § 1, 8-3-1981;
               Ord. No. 1805, § 1, 1-4-1982; Ord. No. 2553, § 2, 9-6-1988)
